state: This review concerns future maintenance of the compiler only. Baseline309644a6881909d8dba32560bc6711f67e00a7ab contains 39 Rust source files with71473 lines and an otherwise empty dependency graph. The README describes a dependency-free implementation; inspected governing requirements do not prescribe that policy. The custom Can grammar and layout, recoverable CST, permission/effect/type semantics and lowering are required language behavior. The separate infrastructure inventory contains handwritten cryptographic hashing, JSON grammar/escaping/output, LSP transport and field assembly, CLI option/help/completion handling, source-map VLQ, URL/file-URI logic, temporal/locale validation and atomic temporary writes. Green unit baseline:89 tests. Additional executed cases reveal valid backspace/formfeed/surrogate-pair escapes being lowered incorrectly (bf followed by two replacement scalars), a unicode URL default panicking on byte-index slicing, malformed IPv6-like hosts and excessive ports admitted, malformed LSP UTF8 converted lossily and accepted, and formatting widening a0600 file to0644. Existing tests do not cover away those results. Reviewed candidate documentation describes SHA256 in sha2, typed/raw JSON and string parsing in serde_json, WHATWG URL/file handling in url, same-filesystem persistence in tempfile and typed protocol shapes in lsp-types. Candidate behavior has not been proven in Can or measured for build time/size/speed. Ordered pair/duplicate JSON members and raw numeric spellings are current custom properties; stock serde_json Value is not a complete substitute. The checked lsp-server0.10 request identifier is only i32 or string, and its frame reader has no64MiB bound like Can. Compatibility must account for depth64, body64MiB, diagnostic/code/output order, lifecycle, exact obligated request IDs, generated JS and exits0/10/2. Advice should fairly compare costs and benefits, and cannot imply permission to change the compiler or choose its custom grammar.

approach.instructions: What direction for the next maintenance proposal follows most reasonably from these facts, rather than from a preference for or against dependencies?

criteria.FRAMEWORK: Adopt a comprehensive framework migration covering syntax storage/parsing/incrementality, JavaScript AST generation and LSP serving. It may unify growing infrastructure; however, it expands compatibility work substantially and lacks present payoff measurements.
criteria.TARGETED: Use small library substitutions for standards-based parts with Can-specific wrappers and explicit preservation tests. It can eliminate duplicated standards machinery, while introducing external upkeep and unresolved binary/build effects that must be checked.
criteria.CUSTOM: Repair and retain all standard machinery in-house and add independent test vectors. It keeps dependency closure and avoids library behavior changes; it also commits the project to maintaining those standards and edge cases itself.
